title: Workflow for Node Replacement and Using the R&R API
description: Decommission faulty GKE TPU hosts using the Repair & Replace (R&R) API by identifying nodepool nodes and applying fault-behavior labels.

step_notes.extract-culprit-hosts: A culprit host must be QUOTED from Pathways' own logs, never inferred and never taken from whatever node a listing happened to return. [[extract-culprit-hosts]] is the only step that produces an attributed node, and it decides repeat offenders on distinct primary incidents rather than raw event counts. Running an isolate without it hands an approval-gated, capacity-destroying action a target with no provenance.
step_notes.resolve-workload-nodes: Establishes the authoritative node scope. Confirm `status: COMPLETE` first; over an INCOMPLETE set every downstream hardware verdict is inconclusive rather than negative.
